description: Next.js with App Router and Server Components
setup: npx create-next-app with App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind
Configure basePath and middleware for auth

components.button: Client component ('use client') with Tailwind variants and RSC-compatible loading
components.modal: Intercepting routes with (.)modal pattern for URL-driven modals
components.form: Server Actions for form handling, useFormState for validation feedback
components.card: Can be Server Component if not interactive; pass data as props
components.navbar: Server Component for static parts, Client Component wrapper for interactive elements
components.table: Server Component for data fetching, Client Component for interactivity

patterns: Server Components as default, Client Components as needed
accessibility: Use next/image for optimized images with built-in lazy loading

description: Vue 3 with Composition API and Script Setup

components.button: Single File Component with <script setup lang='ts'>, props for variant/size
components.card: Scoped CSS with slotted content areas
components.navbar: Composition API with reactive state, transition for mobile menu
components.table: Computed properties for sorting/filtering, scoped styles

description: Nuxt.js with auto-imports and file-based routing
setup: npx nuxi init with TypeScript, Tailwind, Pinia

components.modal: NuxtLayout for persistent overlays, Teleport for rendering
components.form: v-model with server-side validation via useFetch
components.navbar: useState for persistent nav state across pages
components.table: Server-side sorting with useFetch, client-side with computed

patterns: SSG or SSR per page via route rules

description: Svelte with reactive declarations and stores
setup: npx sv create with SvelteKit, TypeScript, Tailwind

components.button: Reactive props with $: declarations, CSS directly in component
components.modal: svelte:portal for teleporting, transitions for enter/leave
components.form: bind:value for two-way binding, actions for validation
components.navbar: Reactive $count store for state, transitions for mobile nav

description: Astro with islands architecture and zero-JS by default
setup: Add Tailwind via astro add tailwind
UI framework components as needed (React, Vue, Svelte)

components.button: Astro component (no JS by default), client:load directive if interactive
components.modal: Islands architecture with client:visible for on-demand loading
components.form: Server endpoints for form handling, ViewTransitions for SPA-like nav
components.card: Pure HTML/CSS Astro component, zero JS overhead
components.navbar: Astro component with client:media for mobile interaction
components.table: Static HTML table, client:load for interactive sorting

accessibility: Zero-JS by default reduces accessibility barriers
Streaming HTML for faster first paint
